scope: Fourth trial: PPLC 'Too many errors - aborting' after 20 W007/W008 warnings
console_report: v3 compiled past the former E106 sites; both methods aborted after 20 messages (v191 at line 4902, v192 at 4839)
diagnosis: PPLC counts warnings toward a 20-message abort. W008 is emitted for every long expression passed to an int parameter (waittimer(int exit_time) per manual p90); W007 for a long delay() count. The v19 method shot passed long tick expressions to waittimer 46 times (v191) / 37 (v192), on top of v18's 11 inherited W007/W008.
predictor_validation: A static AST check reproduced all 20 console messages per method exactly (line = statement end + 1, same order); scale() accepts a long first argument without warning, as in v18.
fix: Generator pass int_timer_arguments(): each long waittimer argument in the method shot is assigned once to an int (v19_i_*) in setup immediately before v19_mode=1, after every feasibility check; long-to-int assignment keeps the same low 16 bits without a warning. Constant arguments become int literals (1000, 8997). v19_wait_next becomes int and is loaded from v19_i_first_wait/v19_i_post_b. The unreferenced v19_shot label (would be W003) is removed.
timing: waittimer arguments are evaluated before the wait, so exits are unchanged; int reads are cheaper than long read plus truncation, so timed windows only gain slack
added_variables: 37 ints in v191 (74 bytes), fewer in v192; v19_wait_next long->int saves 2 bytes
other_warning_checks: No identifiers > 31 chars (W002), no unused labels (W003), no assignment conditions (W005), no long array index arguments (W006)
event_identity_vs_v3: RF, gradient memory/samples/segments, ADC timing, printed output, v19_error_code and timer-overrun flags identical over two shots in 14 cases per method
